title: Nvidia board weighs fate of CEO Jensen Huang after affair with alleged Chinese spy - The Washington Post
description: The powerful chief executive of the AI chipmaker recently admitted to the affair.

title: World's fastest ocean liner is sunk to break another record: largest artificial reef - NPR
description: The SS United States broke trans-Atlantic speed records. On Wednesday, it was sunk off the Florida coast and will become a diving destination and home for marine life.

title: Pope Leo returns to Peru, his adopted homeland - The Washington Post
description: After spending decades in Peru as a missionary and bishop, the first American pope is back in his second home.

title: Dangerous search for survivors continues after deadly building collapse in Brooklyn - CNN
description: Several people are dead, including at least one child, after a mixed-use three-story building in New York City collapsed Wednesday afternoon, a city official said. Over a dozen people are injured.
